title: Meet central counterplay first
summary: Develop while answering the central pawn advance; do not ignore attacks on your pieces.

fromNode.nodeId: e4 c5 Nc3 e6 f4 d5

goal: Develop while answering the central pawn advance; do not ignore attacks on your pieces.

steps.text: Identify what the opposing d-pawn attacks before choosing your next move.
Develop with a threat or check when it also meets the immediate problem.
Move an attacked piece or exchange a defender instead of continuing a pawn attack automatically.

jobs.text: The knight controls e4 and d5 from here.
The pawn controls d5 from here.
The pawn controls e5 from here.

opponent.text: Black can advance the d-pawn again to attack a knight on c3. Count that threat before adding more king-side space.

notNow: Do not ignore a direct central attack just because you have already started a king-side setup.

mistakes.text: The bishop on c4 can be taken by the pawn on d5. Do not sacrifice a developed piece without a concrete follow-up.

comments.text: Bring your knight to f3. From f3 it controls d4 and e5. Keep watching Black's replies before advancing more pawns.
Bring your bishop to b5. Give check, so Black must answer the attack on the king.
Bring your knight to e2. From e2 it controls d4. Keep watching Black's replies before advancing more pawns.
Capture the knight with your bishop. Give check, so Black must answer the attack on the king.
